en: Soldier. Head, labrum and pronotum reddish yellow, the forehead and mandibles red-brown; antennae, legs and abdomen yellow. Hairs on the head are few, while the labrum and pronotum carry stouter setae and the abdominal tergites sparse long ones. Head rectangular, rather stout and short, the sides slightly parallel, the forehead raised on both sides with a shallow median hollow. Mandibles short and thick, three marginal teeth on the left and two on the right. Labrum oval-oblong with a bluntly rounded fore margin, about as long as wide. Antennae ten segmented, the third short and small. Postmentum widest a little in front of the middle, less than twice as wide as its narrowest part. Pronotum butterfly-shaped, with a wide anterior emargination.
soldier: 兵蚁头部、上唇与前胸背板赤黄，前额与上颚红褐，触角、足及腹部黄。头部毛少，上唇和前胸背板刚毛较多，腹部背板有稀疏长刚毛。头壳长方形，较粗短，两侧略平行，前额左右稍隆起而中间微低凹。上颚粗短，左上颚三枚缘齿，右上颚二枚。上唇长圆形，前缘圆钝，长宽几乎相等。触角十节，第三节短小。后颏以中部偏前处最宽，前缘及腰部收缩处最窄，最宽处不及最窄处的两倍。前胸背板形似展翅的蝶，前缘为宽凹缘，后缘微凹。
